% A test for tex8web: a document set in Times, Helvetica and Courier
% (mathptmx, helvet, courier), whose page is set in TeX Gyre's equivalents,
% Termes, Heros and Cursor, each cut down to the page's characters.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{mathptmx}
\usepackage[scaled=0.92]{helvet}
\usepackage{courier}
\begin{document}
\section{Times}
Text in Times, \emph{in italics}, \textbf{in bold}, \textsf{in Helvetica} and
\texttt{in Courier}, with $x^2$ in math.
\end{document}
